proposed_system_of_record: Control calendar and owner certification register
procedure: Quarterly, collect each owner's execution counts, exceptions and overdue actions; compare certifications with underlying records; label the result management self-assessment.
Select risk-based controls and sites; inspect source evidence separately from owner attestations; record scope limitations and escalate deviations.
Define the objective, boundary, period and independent population query before selection; record selection rationale; execute each attribute test and preserve failed and untested cases.
Assign severity, accountable role and due date when a finding opens; link corrective work and independent retest; escalate overdue items; retain original failures after closure.

Walk each critical service from Reno loss through Boise recovery; record outage impacts, dependencies, tolerable outage, recovery order, RTO, RPO and required resources; obtain business acceptance annually and after material change.
Assign each dataset a schedule derived from its approved RPO; record retention and isolation; monitor every scheduled job; ticket missed or failed runs and reconcile protected datasets to inventory.

Select critical datasets and recovery paths using documented risk; restore into an isolated environment; measure recovery time and recovered data age; validate integrity and usability against the BIA; record failures and retest.
reviewer_role_description: Service owner distinct from restore operator

procedure: Exercise primary-site loss, recovery-site operation and return to service annually and after major change; include suppliers and customer dependencies; record decision times, communications, capacity and lessons; update plans and retest failures.

Record assets, software, services, owners, locations and lifecycle states at onboarding/change/retirement; reconcile identity, endpoint, network, provider and deployment discovery to inventory; resolve unowned resources.
Version the intended configuration for each technology; compare deployed settings to the approved baseline; investigate drift and link correction or an expiring exception.
Name a steward for each dataset; classify by sensitivity and contractual restrictions; validate the classification at intake and material change; propagate it to storage, sharing and retention rules.

proposed_system_of_record: Processing register and privacy case queue
procedure: Record purpose, authority, parties, PHI role, designated record set and approved flows before processing; verify request authority and minimum-necessary conditions; route access, amendment and accounting support through the upstream agreement; preserve decisions.

Map each record class to legal and contractual retention and the retention start event; separate security documentation from clinical records; resolve conflicts and holds before enabling deletion; review the schedule annually and on obligation change.

Define completeness, accuracy and provenance checks for material datasets; record failed checks and usage restrictions; process authorized corrections with before/after lineage and downstream notification where required.
reviewer_role_description: Data steward distinct from change executor

procedure: For every material change, identify business intent, affected services/data, risks and owner; link commitments and source requirements before implementation; include period-change description impacts.
Require peer review of the exact proposed revision; check separation from author and protected-branch rules; route emergency bypasses to the documented emergency workflow.

Choose tests from change risk including security, privacy, recovery and data effects; bind results to the release artifact; block release on failed mandatory tests unless an authorized exception applies.

Release only approved artifacts using attributable deployment identities; reconcile pipeline runs with actual runtime versions and out-of-band changes; record target environment and rollback reference.

Record emergency reason, affected boundary, limited authority and recovery plan before execution where feasible; preserve timestamps and bypass scope; obtain retrospective review and correct recurring bypass causes.
reviewer_role_description: Emergency authority and later independent reviewer

procedure: For each material release, identify rollback prerequisites, irreversible data effects and stop conditions; test recovery in a representative environment; require a tested recovery alternative when rollback is infeasible.

Reconcile service, technology, supplier, people and legal risks quarterly and when threats change; score impact and likelihood with evidence; assign treatment, residual exposure and affected controls.

proposed_system_of_record: Risk appetite and service commitment register
procedure: Translate proposed service commitments into measurable tolerances and escalation triggers; submit tolerances for management acceptance; review annually and before major changes.
Review accepted exposure quarterly and at threshold breach; check authority, expiry and compensating measures; escalate unacceptable or expired acceptance and preserve previous decisions.

Before a new service, location or major operating change, review security, privacy, legal, supplier, recovery and capacity implications; record go/no-go conditions and track closure before activation.
Distribute approved conduct expectations at onboarding and annually; reconcile the recipient population; follow up missing acknowledgments and route reported violations through protected channels.
Review override, incentives, related-party and contracting abuse scenarios annually and for high-risk transactions; assign preventive and detective measures and record unresolved conflicts.

Maintain governing-body and committee mandates, expertise expectations and reporting duties; schedule oversight of service risks and control deficiencies; retain approved versions and meeting decisions.
Publish reserved matters and approval limits; verify approving authority at each material decision; resolve conflicting or expired delegations before execution.
Collect annual and event-driven declarations; assess independence and committee eligibility; record recusals and substitute decision authority in relevant proceedings.

proposed_system_of_record: Authoritative personnel/service request and identity directory
procedure: Create a unique identity only from an approved worker, contractor or service request; bind sponsor, start/end dates and identity proofing; reconcile creations with authoritative requests.

proposed_system_of_record: Access request queue and entitlement catalogue
procedure: Record business need, role, boundary and duration; obtain resource-owner approval; check conflicting privileges; provision only approved rights and confirm actual grants.

proposed_system_of_record: Personnel change feed and entitlement catalogue
procedure: On role change, compare old and new required rights; revoke obsolete entitlements as well as grant approved additions; reconcile applications and site access to the change.

proposed_system_of_record: Personnel termination feed and application/site directories
procedure: At termination or contract expiry, use the authorized effective time to disable accounts, sessions, tokens, remote access and physical credentials; reconcile every connected system; escalate missed revocations immediately.
reviewer_role_description: People owner and independent access reviewer

proposed_system_of_record: Privileged access vault and emergency access log
procedure: Issue privileged access separately with purpose and duration; record emergency activation and session activity; expire access, rotate exposed credentials and review each emergency use plus quarterly privilege population.
reviewer_role_description: Privileged service owner other than user

procedure: Record owner, workload, permissions, dependencies and credential lifecycle for every non-human account; constrain grants and rotation according to approved risk requirements; review quarterly and on ownership change.

Quarterly for privileged access and at a risk-approved cadence for other rights, reconcile HR/contractor records to actual entitlements; require owner decisions per account; independently confirm removals and overdue escalation.

Assign severity and commander at discovery; activate escalation, preservation and communications; for suspected PHI breaches route discovery time and upstream notification requirements to legal/privacy; exercise contacts annually.

Preserve chronology, affected data/services, containment, decisions and communications; assess breach exceptions and documented compromise factors; maintain legal and contract notification clocks and known missing facts.
For defined incident classes, reconstruct contributing factors from evidence; distinguish proximate failure from systemic causes; assign preventive actions and update risk and recovery plans.
Track each incident action to an owner, due date and measurable completion condition; validate the fix with evidence; escalate overdue or ineffective actions.

Bind obligations to source edition, citation, effective period, entity role and boundary; classify direct, delegated, conditional and enforcement context; check amendments and judicial status quarterly and at legal events.
Before signature, reconcile service scope, data rights, BA/subcontractor duties, notification timing, liabilities, assurance access and exit terms; verify delegation and unresolved redlines.
Maintain owner, approver, version, effective/review dates and distribution for each policy; link operational procedures; withdraw obsolete versions and review annually or at material change.
Bind each control to stable ID, objective, owner role, boundary and evidence expectation; evaluate source-mapping impact before changes; version designs and preserve review history.

Record the exact requirement, rationale, risk, alternatives, compensating measure, approver and expiry; for HIPAA addressable measures document reasonableness and equivalent alternatives; block silent waivers and escalate expiry.
Compare local and provider designs to the enterprise control; record the reason, responsibility split and additional measures; review changes and verify local evidence before accepting inheritance.
reviewer_role_description: Enterprise control owner and site service owner

procedure: Determine screening and qualification needs by role and jurisdiction before start; obtain permitted checks; resolve adverse or incomplete results through authorized People/legal review before granting sensitive access.
Capture actor, timestamp/timezone, boundary, input, decision and outcome for material control events; link approvals and protect records from unauthorized alteration; reconcile missing event records.
Record source, query, parameters, timezone, period and raw count; reconcile against an independent population source; record omissions and access limits before using the extract.
Retain raw and derived files separately; record transform code/version, parameters and hashes; reperform joins, exclusions and aggregations and reconcile row counts.

At scheduled disposal or exit, check retention and holds; execute authorized deletion or destruction across active copies and documented backup lifecycle; retain certificates and investigate failed deletions.
reviewer_role_description: Legal hold owner and data owner

procedure: Document trust zones, data flows, administrative paths, authentication, key custody and supplier responsibilities for both sites; assess threat scenarios and minimum requirements before material architecture change.
Inventory required log sources and detections; monitor ingestion and clock gaps; route alerts with severity and ownership; test representative detections and collection-loss alerts.

Reconcile asset coverage across scanners, testing and advisories; validate findings; assign remediation against approved severity/exploitability SLAs; verify fixes by rescan or record expiring acceptance.
Enforce approved host, endpoint, SaaS and network settings; restrict unauthorized software and flows; detect exceptions and link to remediation or approved time-limited deviation.
Escalate material threats into incident command; preserve original alerts and source evidence; record containment authority and actions; reconcile closed alerts to incident criteria.
Before onboarding, classify service criticality, data/access, concentration and recovery dependency; record PHI/subcontractor role and required diligence tier.
Obtain tier-appropriate security, privacy, continuity and financial evidence; inspect report scope, period, exceptions and customer controls; record gaps and conditions before onboarding or renewal.

Translate service, security, BA, subcontractor, incident, evidence, continuity and exit requirements into clauses and named responsible parties; reconcile signed terms with technical design and upstream promises.
At the risk-based cadence, review performance, incidents, assurance exceptions, subcontractor changes, financial exposure and concentration; track breach of terms and corrective action.

Plan service transfer before termination; revoke supplier identities and connections; obtain data return/destruction or continuing-protection rationale; verify residual backups and open financial obligations.
Map worker and contractor populations to conduct, security, privacy and incident training; update at onboarding and role/obligation change; specify refresher cadence and competency checks.
Monthly, reconcile required learners to course completions; notify overdue learners and managers; escalate persistent gaps and record approved exceptions.
Define competence and continuity requirements for critical roles; verify qualifications and practical capability; address gaps with training, supervision or backup coverage.
